name: HnswStore::upsert / search

test_list.description: A malformed vector rejects the whole batch without changing SQLite, index count, or search results.
Upsert is idempotent by chunk id and a replacement moves the nearest-neighbor result and payload.
Payload-filtered search returns k eligible neighbors even when closer ineligible rows exist.
Searching an empty table or requesting zero results yields an empty list.
Returned scores are finite and sorted from the closest eligible vector down.
For deterministic arbitrary finite vectors, querying an inserted vector returns that id first.

inputs.name: chunks
inputs.description: A batch of finite, dimension-matched vectors and CAS payload references.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Finite query vector with the table dimension.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Maximum number of eligible nearest neighbors.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Optional allowed payload set applied before the result limit.

output_description: Nearest eligible vectors with normalized higher-is-closer scores.
